# SparsePacker

Research artifact for the paper:

**SparsePacker: Cost-Aware Candidate Packing for Exact Filtered Vector Search**

## Download

Visit the [Releases page](https://github.com/Dot-a11/SparsePacker/releases).

1. Open the release titled **SparsePacker — EDBT 2027 Submission Artifact**.
2. Expand the **Assets** section.
3. Download **SparsePacker.new.zip**.
4. Extract the archive to access the submission artifact.

**Please download `SparsePacker.new.zip`, not the automatically generated
`Source code (zip)` or `Source code (tar.gz)` archives.**
